quests.scene: A colleague says: Thank you so much for helping me yesterday!
quests.hint: This is a polite exchange between two friendly colleagues.
quests.explanation: You are welcome! is the natural warm response to a thank you.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You have been waiting at the airport for six hours because your flight was cancelled.
quests.hint: Long unexpected waits drain your physical and mental energy.
quests.explanation: After six hours of waiting you feel exhausted.

quests.scene: A shop assistant says: Have a nice day!
quests.hint: This is a friendly standard closing phrase in everyday interactions.
quests.explanation: You too! is the natural friendly way to respond when someone wishes you well.

quests.scene: Your friend calls and says: I have some really exciting news!
quests.hint: Show genuine interest in what your friend wants to share.
quests.explanation: Tell me! is the enthusiastic natural response that shows you are interested and ready to listen.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You watch the baggage carousel at the airport and your bag never arrives.
quests.hint: Your belongings may have been lost.
quests.explanation: Watching the carousel without seeing your bag makes you feel anxious.

quests.scene: A stranger asks you: Excuse me do you know what time it is?
options: Why do you want to know?
I do not speak to strangers.
Sorry I do not have a watch.
quests.hint: You genuinely do not know the time but want to be helpful.
quests.explanation: Sorry I do not have a watch is honest and polite.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: After one year living abroad you think back on all the people and moments you experienced.
quests.hint: Thinking about happy times that are now in the past creates a particular feeling.
quests.explanation: Looking back on meaningful experiences brings a feeling of nostalgia.

quests.scene: Your teacher says: Excellent work on your essay!
options: Thank you I worked really hard on it.
quests.hint: Accept the praise with genuine gratitude and humility.
quests.explanation: Thank you I worked really hard on it accepts the compliment graciously.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You notice that your neighbour has a garden filled with beautiful colorful flowers.
quests.hint: You admire what they have and wish you had something similar.
quests.explanation: Seeing something beautiful that you wish were yours can make you feel envious.

quests.scene: A hotel receptionist asks: Do you have a reservation?
quests.hint: Provide the specific information the receptionist needs.
quests.explanation: When a receptionist asks about your reservation giving your name is the most efficient response.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You and your partner find out you are expecting a baby for the very first time.
quests.hint: This is life-changing news that brings enormous responsibility and joy.
quests.explanation: Finding out you are expecting a baby for the first time brings a mix of joy and responsibility.

quests.scene: Your friend asks: Would you like to grab a coffee later today?
quests.hint: Your friend wants to spend time with you.
quests.explanation: I'd love to! What time? is a warm enthusiastic acceptance.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You arrive at a party where you do not know a single person.
quests.hint: All the faces around you are completely unfamiliar.
quests.explanation: Being at a social event where you know nobody makes you feel self-conscious.

quests.scene: A waiter comes to your table and asks: Is everything all right with your meal?
quests.hint: Give honest positive feedback if the food and service are good.
quests.explanation: Yes it's delicious thank you! is the friendly natural reply when you are happy with your meal.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You read a news report that pollution levels in your city are getting worse every year.
quests.hint: The health and environment of your community are at risk.
quests.explanation: Reading about environmental problems in your city makes you feel concerned.

quests.scene: Your boss emails you: Please have next week's report ready by Friday.
options: I'll have it ready by Friday. Thank you.
quests.hint: Acknowledge the instruction and confirm you will complete it.
quests.explanation: I'll have it ready by Friday. Thank you. is the professional response.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You score the winning goal in the final second of the match.
quests.hint: The best possible thing has happened at the most dramatic moment!
quests.explanation: Scoring the winning goal at the last second creates euphoria.

quests.scene: A pharmacist says: Take these tablets twice a day always with food.
options: Understood twice a day with food.
quests.hint: Repeat the key instruction back to confirm you understood.
quests.explanation: Saying Understood twice a day with food confirms you understood the prescription.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You receive a letter saying your rent is being increased by thirty percent.
quests.hint: A large and unfair financial demand has been placed on you without warning.
quests.explanation: A sudden large rent increase causes outrage.

quests.scene: A friend calls to say: I'm sorry I'm going to be about twenty minutes late.
quests.hint: Your friend has communicated early and apologized which is considerate.
quests.explanation: No problem! I'll wait here is the relaxed understanding response.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You find out you are the only person who wore formal clothes to the office on a casual Friday.
quests.hint: Everyone else in the office is dressed very differently from you.
quests.explanation: Being clearly overdressed for an occasion makes you feel mortified.

quests.scene: A receptionist says: Please take a seat. Someone will be with you shortly.
quests.hint: This is completely standard and polite waiting room language.
quests.explanation: Thank you is the polite and natural acknowledgment.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You watch your toddler take their very first steps across the room.
quests.hint: This is a milestone moment in your child's development.
quests.explanation: Watching your child walk for the first time is a deeply emotional experience.

quests.scene: A taxi driver asks: Where to?
quests.hint: The driver needs to know your destination immediately.
quests.explanation: To the airport please is the direct polite way to tell a taxi driver your destination.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You successfully negotiate a lower price for a car after some firm but polite discussion.
quests.hint: You achieved a better deal than the original asking price.
quests.explanation: Successfully negotiating a better price makes you feel triumphant.

quests.scene: A colleague says: I think I made a mistake in the report. Could you check it?
options: Of course I'll take a look.
quests.hint: A colleague is asking for teamwork and professional support.
quests.explanation: Of course I'll take a look shows willingness to help.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You open your work email to find two hundred unread messages.
quests.hint: There is far far too much to deal with all at once.
quests.explanation: Seeing a massive inbox full of unread emails makes you feel overwhelmed.

quests.scene: A shop assistant says: I'm sorry we're completely out of stock of that item.
options: Oh that's a shame. Do you know when it will be back?
quests.hint: The assistant has delivered this news politely and helpfully.
quests.explanation: Oh that's a shame. Do you know when it will be back? is the mature helpful response.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You spend a relaxing afternoon reading your favorite book by the window on a quiet day.
quests.hint: Everything around you is calm comfortable and pleasant.
quests.explanation: A quiet afternoon with your favorite book creates a feeling of peace.

quests.scene: Your doctor says: You need to reduce your daily sugar intake.
options: Thank you I'll do my best to change my diet.
quests.hint: Your doctor is giving you important health advice.
quests.explanation: Thank you I'll do my best shows you take the medical advice seriously.
